# `oaap app promote`

ship the tested artifact to production (RFC-0020).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app promote [--to TO] [--confirm]
                        [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT] [--keep-name]
                        name
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | test instance to promote FROM |
| `--to TO` | production instance, named inside the test instance's tenant and without its short name (default: the test instance's name without '-test') |
| `--confirm` | accept an envelope widening reported as NOTE |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
| `--keep-name` | --to really starts with the tenant's label |
